annotations.title: Token safety check (honeypot detector, rug check)

description: Token safety check / honeypot detector / rug pull check / scam token scanner for an ERC-20 contract or Solana mint. Returns a verdict safe | caution | danger with risk_score, confidence and reasons, plus a simulated buy-transfer-sell honeypot test with buy/sell/transfer tax %, mint/blacklist/pause/fee-setter/trading-switch flags, owner renounced?, proxy, Sourcify verification, liquidity in USD and holder/creator concentration. Chains: Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Robinhood Chain, Solana. ax1-compatible (AX1 Verdict drop-in). $0.01 USDC on Base via x402; failed checks are not charged. Informational, not financial advice. Price: $0.01 per token. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

address.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint

chain.description: Token chain (payment is always USDC on Base)

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key: same payer + requestKey + input returns the stored result without a second charge (7 days).

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.
